supabase.query: SELECT clock_timestamp() AS observed_at, to_regclass('public.tweet_pattern_review_items')::text AS queue_table, (SELECT max(version) FROM supabase_migrations.schema_migrations) AS latest_hosted_version, COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('version', version,'name', name) ORDER BY version) FROM supabase_migrations.schema_migrations WHERE version IN ('20261121190000','20261121173000') OR name ILIKE '%sync_tweet_review_sources%'), '[]'::jsonb) AS matching_migrations, COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('signature', p.oid::regprocedure::text, 'security_definer', p.prosecdef, 'grants', p.proacl::text, 'definition', pg_get_functiondef(p.oid))) FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname = 'sync_tweet_review_sources_v1'), '[]'::jsonb) AS public_rpc_overloads
